reviews.t: How about a man's perspective for a change?
reviews.x: It kind of irritates me that products like this are always targeted for women; as if men don't care about their appearance or fighting aging (OK, I guess many don't, but they're are exceptions like me).  I only used this once so far, but was truly impressed with how my skin looked afterwards.  I felt like it took 5 years off my face (I already look young for my late 40's.  This put me squarely in my late 30's).  I plan on using twice weekly and hope it has a cumulative effect.  I'm so impressed

I got this MegaMud as a gift and it's fantastic.  It's easy to apply AND rinse off, unlike other muds I've tried.  Even after the very first use, my skin was significantly softer and smoother - even the next morning! Because it goes on so easily, and since you only need a small amount for each mask, the jar will last for a long time.  It's got great quality ingredients that I'm comfortable using on my skin.

Yes, there was a tingling sensation and a very mild burning sensation, but that mostly dissipated after 1 to 2 minutes. I left the product on for 8 to 10 minutes my first time with no complications, redness, irritation, or even pinkness. I noticed immediately smaller pores, a soft glow, and skin smooth to the touch. Stay tuned for my update!

This stuff is awesome! I have sensitive skin that is a little bit oily. I've gone through a whole tub and I'm about to get more. I love watching this product dry onto my face and see all of the oily dots appear where I'm most oily. Sometimes, just so it lasts longer, I just put it on my T-zone and on my nose. However, one tub still lasts months because you only need a thin layer per use. This is the one product that I will absolute splurge on. Worth the cost. I have not found anything better.

The scent is not the most pleasant, king of a mix of sulfur and petrol. After rinsing, most of the smell is gone. I may purchase again, but this jar will last a long time.

This is one of the best mud masks I have ever used.  In fact, I love it so much that I have sent it to family and friends as gifts, and they love it as well.  It makes my skin feel so smooth after using it, not tight and drawn like others.  This VIA Megamud mask is full of good things for your skin, and I will continue to purchase it.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently report softer, smoother, and clearer skin after use, often noting results after just one or two applications.
Many reviewers describe the mask as easy to apply and rinse off, with a pleasant feel and texture during use.
Opinions on the smell are mixed: some find it unpleasant or astringent/earthy, while others report no unpleasant smell or a mild minty scent.
Several reviewers note the container is small or contains only a small amount of product, though some say a little goes a long way.
Some sensitive-skin reviewers mention tingling or mild burning sensations, which typically subsided quickly.
